description: OWASP MCP09:2025 — discover MCP client configs in well-known host paths (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, VS Code, Claude Code) and flag servers that are not on an organization allowlist (Shadow MCP). Does not start any MCP server.

allowlist.description: JSON allowlist: {"names":["filesystem"],"packages":["@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem"],"hosts":["mcp.example.com"]} or line form name:/package:/host:

home.description: Override home directory used to resolve well-known config paths

includeContentAudit.description: Also run the normal config content checks on each discovered file (default false)

name: discover_shadow_mcp
